nodes.name: memory-core plugin entry
nodes.summary: definePluginEntry registers the memory capability (recallToolNames memory_search/memory_get, promptBuilder, flushPlanResolver, runtime, publicArtifacts), the memory_search/memory_get/intent tools, the before_prompt_build standing-intent hook, the /dreaming command, and the memory CLI.

nodes.name: memory tool implementations
nodes.summary: createMemorySearchTool/createMemoryGetTool execute memory_search/memory_get with corpus selection, deadline control, wiki blending, citation presentation, and short-term recall recording.

nodes.name: memory tool contracts
nodes.summary: Tool schemas and description contracts for memory_search/memory_get plus buildMemoryPromptSection, which renders the Memory Recall guidance lines.

nodes.name: session transcript ingestion
nodes.summary: Scans interactive session transcript sources, classifies per-line provenance, dedups by hash, applies admission policy/tombstones, and appends rendered snippets to memory/.dreams/session-corpus/<day>.txt.

nodes.name: memory entry origins
nodes.summary: Records/lists/prunes entry origin rows in the per-agent agent SQLite db and transfers parent origins across consolidation, backing memory forget lineage.

nodes.name: short-term promotion ranking
nodes.summary: Ranks staged short-term recall candidates with weighted frequency/relevance/diversity/recency/consolidation/conceptual signals and phase boosts before promotion.

nodes.name: dreaming sweep
nodes.summary: runShortTermDreamingPromotion runs the three-phase sweep, ranks candidates, applies promotions into MEMORY.md, writes the DREAMS report and narrative; registerShortTermPromotionDreaming wires the cron.

nodes.name: promotion gates
nodes.summary: isPromotionOriginBlocked structurally excludes untrusted/system candidates; isConsolidationCandidateEligible admits only owner/agent provenance.

nodes.name: memory flush plan
nodes.summary: buildMemoryFlushPlan produces the pre-compaction flush prompt/systemPrompt, date-stamped target memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md, soft threshold, force byte size, and reserve floor.

nodes.name: hybrid result fusion
nodes.summary: mergeHybridResults fuses vector+keyword legs by weight, preserves exact-path tiers, then applies temporal decay, importance, project ranking and MMR; selectHybridSearchResults enforces minScore.

nodes.name: importance multiplier
nodes.summary: importanceMultiplier maps 1..10 importance to 0.75+n*0.05 and treats null as neutral; applyImportanceMultiplier scales result scores.

nodes.name: temporal decay
nodes.summary: applyTemporalDecayToHybridResults applies exp(-(ln2/halfLife)*ageDays) to dated memory/ and session sources while MEMORY.md/USER.md/undated files stay evergreen.

nodes.name: MMR diversity re-ranking
nodes.summary: applyMMRToHybridResults reorders candidates with lambda*relevance-(1-lambda)*maxJaccardSimilarity over snippet tokens (fixed lambda 0.7).

nodes.name: project ranking
nodes.summary: projectScoreMultiplier boosts 1.15 when all stored project keys are active, demotes 0.9 otherwise, and drops invalid-annotation entries.

nodes.name: search orchestration
nodes.summary: MemorySearchOrchestration.search runs FTS5 keyword + vector legs, handles provider fallback/index identity repair, merges via mergeHybridResults, and selects results.

nodes.name: keyword retrieval
nodes.summary: builds FTS5 MATCH queries, ranks with bm25()/bm25RankToScore, supports path-FTS and LIKE fallback, and produces KeywordSearchHit rows.

nodes.name: chunk writer
nodes.summary: createMemoryChunkWriter upserts memory_index_chunks, memory_index_chunk_recall_metadata and memory_index_chunk_provenance rows (untrusted/unknown fallback) per chunk.

nodes.name: source index kernel
nodes.summary: Replaces a source's chunks/embeddings atomically, writes chunks via the chunk writer and vectors, and cleans up stale chunk rows.

nodes.name: keyword query helpers
nodes.summary: bm25RankToScore converts SQLite bm25() rank to a positive score; buildFtsQuery/buildMatchQueryFromTerms build MATCH expressions.

nodes.name: search manager factory
nodes.summary: getMemorySearchManager resolves config/workspace access and constructs the MemoryIndexManager; close helpers release managers.

nodes.name: memory corpus aggregation
nodes.summary: Ranks/blends supplement (wiki) corpus results and enforces the memory_search/memory_get deadline with composeMemoryCorpusMetadata warnings.

nodes.name: session hit visibility
nodes.summary: filterMemorySearchHitsBySessionVisibility applies tools.sessions.visibility and cross-agent scoping to session transcript hits.

nodes.name: standing intents
nodes.summary: create/list/cancel/match/sweep event-conditioned standing intents, matched on prompt via keywords and injected as hidden context.

nodes.name: standing intents store
nodes.summary: SQLite persistence and FTS shadow for standing intents: insert/update/select rows and keyword search joining standing_intents_fts.

nodes.name: active-memory plugin entry
nodes.summary: Registers the active-memory command, the before_prompt_build hook that runs lane-1 trigger recall, private-transcript cross-conversation recall, and lane-2 escalation recall.

nodes.name: trigger recall lane 1
nodes.summary: loads lexical-only candidates, scores stored trigger phrases against the inbound message, selects strong matches (>=0.65, top 3), and builds a compact prefixed context block.

nodes.name: recall escalation
nodes.summary: hasRecallIntent detects past/temporal phrasing; resolveRecallEscalationDecision decides recall vs skip for escalate/always/off modes.

nodes.name: memory-wiki plugin entry
nodes.summary: Registers wiki prompt supplement/preparation and corpus supplement, gateway methods, services, and the wiki_status/wiki_lint/wiki_apply/wiki_search/wiki_get tools.

nodes.name: wiki tools
nodes.summary: wiki_status/search/get/apply/lint tool implementations with WikiClaimSchema/WikiClaimEvidenceSchema validation, contradictions, and provenance-gap linting.

nodes.name: wiki compiler
nodes.summary: Compiles the vault, computes claim health, and renders dashboards including contradictions and low-confidence claims.

nodes.name: memory index schema setup
nodes.summary: ensureMemoryIndexSchema builds canonical+derived tables, migrates sources identity, installs revision triggers, provenance/recall tables, STRICT migration, and FTS availability.

nodes.name: canonical schema SQL
nodes.summary: Defines memory_index_chunks, memory_index_sources, memory_embedding_cache, memory_index_state STRICT schemas and the rebuild-safe derived-table ordering.

nodes.name: FTS5 schema
nodes.summary: Creates/validates memory_index_chunks_fts and memory_index_paths_fts virtual tables, triggers, and rebuilds with unicode61/trigram tokenizers.

nodes.name: provenance schema
nodes.summary: memory_index_chunk_provenance table (origin_class/session_kind/observed_at/supersedes_key) with FK to chunks and untrusted/unknown backfill.

nodes.name: recall metadata schema
nodes.summary: memory_index_chunk_recall_metadata table (importance CHECK 1..10, triggers, project_key) and migration out of legacy chunk columns.

nodes.name: session file projection
nodes.summary: buildSessionEntry projects transcripts into content/lines/timestamps/lineProvenance, drops heartbeat/recalled-memory/cron/dreaming-narrative turns, and hashes a snapshot.

nodes.name: message origin classifier
nodes.summary: classifySessionMessageOrigin maps user/assistant messages (+turnOrigin, turnTainted, senderIsOwner, internal_system) to owner/agent/untrusted/system.

nodes.name: curated annotation parsing
nodes.summary: extractCuratedEntryRecallMetadata parses trigger/importance/project comments into recall metadata; normalizeProjectAnnotationKey validates keys.

nodes.name: memory host types
nodes.summary: Shared contracts: MemoryOriginClass, MemorySessionKind, MemoryEntryProvenance, MemorySearchResult, and isMemoryOriginEligibleForAutomaticInjection.

nodes.name: memory plugin state
nodes.summary: prepareMemoryPromptSection/buildMemoryPromptSection build a run-scoped immutable memory prompt snapshot; getMemoryRuntime/getMemoryProviderRuntime and flush-plan resolution expose the selected capability.

nodes.name: memory provider adapter
nodes.summary: Adapts the legacy MemorySearchManager to MemoryProviderHandle; convert() attaches automaticRecall {eligible,projectKeys,triggers,importance} used by lane-1 injection.

nodes.name: context engine delegates
nodes.summary: delegateCompactionToRuntime bridges to built-in compaction; buildMemorySystemPromptAddition/prepareMemorySystemPromptAddition expose the memory prompt to plugin engines.

nodes.name: legacy context engine
nodes.summary: LegacyContextEngine implements ContextEngine as ingest no-op / assemble pass-through / compact=delegateCompactionToRuntime (the default engine).

nodes.name: project memory bootstrap
nodes.summary: filterProjectScopedCuratedContextFiles prunes curated files by active project keys; buildProjectMemoryBootstrap renders a budgeted Project Memory block.

nodes.name: sessions_search tool
nodes.summary: createSessionsSearchTool searches visible past-session transcripts via the Gateway and returns sessionKey/messageId/sessionId for sessions_history.

nodes.name: agent bootstrap files
nodes.summary: Builds bootstrap context files (AGENTS/SOUL/MEMORY/USER) with per-file budget limits and a fixed USER.md cap.

nodes.name: Memory architecture doc
nodes.summary: End-to-end architecture: tiers, provenance, dreaming gates, recall lanes, project scope, security model, config map.

nodes.name: Memory search doc
nodes.summary: Hybrid search pipeline, providers, recency decay, MMR, session memory search, visibility.

nodes.name: Context engine doc
nodes.summary: ContextEngine lifecycle interface, legacy vs plugin engines, ownsCompaction, host requirements, failure isolation.

nodes.name: Provenance and deletion doc
nodes.summary: Lineage records, admission policy, memory forget purge semantics and boundaries.

nodes.name: Builtin engine doc
nodes.summary: SQLite backend: FTS5/keyword/vector/hybrid, index location, chunking, maintenance, QMD migration.

nodes.name: memory CLI doc
nodes.summary: Command reference for status/index/reset/search/forget/promote/rem-backfill/session-backfill.

nodes.name: memory_index_chunks
nodes.summary: STRICT table of indexed chunks (id,path,source,start_line,end_line,hash,model,text,embedding BLOB,updated_at).

nodes.name: memory_index_sources
nodes.summary: STRICT source rows (id,path,source,hash,mtime,size, UNIQUE(path,source)) with revision triggers.

nodes.name: memory_embedding_cache
nodes.summary: STRICT embedding cache keyed by (provider,model,provider_key,hash) with dims and updated_at.

nodes.name: memory_index_chunk_provenance
nodes.summary: Per-chunk authoritative provenance (origin_class CHECK owner/agent/untrusted/system, session_kind, observed_at, supersedes_key).

nodes.name: memory_index_chunk_recall_metadata
nodes.summary: Per-chunk recall metadata (importance CHECK 1..10, triggers, project_key) kept out of the canonical chunk table.

nodes.name: memory_index_chunks_fts
nodes.summary: FTS5 virtual table over chunk text using unicode61/trigram tokenizers for BM25 keyword search.

nodes.name: standing_intents
nodes.summary: Per-agent SQLite table of event-conditioned intents with an FTS shadow for keyword matching.

nodes.name: memory index STRICT schema
nodes.summary: buildMemoryIndexStrictSchema composes canonical tables; MEMORY_INDEX_DERIVED_TABLES declares rebuild order.

nodes.name: mergeHybridResults
nodes.summary: Fuses vector and keyword candidates with weights, exact-path tiers, temporal decay, importance, project ranking and MMR.

nodes.name: applyImportanceMultiplier
nodes.summary: Scales result scores by 0.75+clamp(importance)*0.05 (neutral when null).

nodes.name: applyTemporalDecayToHybridResults
nodes.summary: Exponentially decays dated memory/session results by age with configured half-life; evergreen files untouched.

nodes.name: applyMMRToHybridResults
nodes.summary: Greedy MMR re-ranking with Jaccard token similarity and lambda weighting.

nodes.name: projectScoreMultiplier
nodes.summary: Returns 1.15 when all stored project keys are active, 0.9 otherwise, 1 when untagged.

nodes.name: createMemoryChunkWriter
nodes.summary: Upserts chunk, recall-metadata, and provenance rows for one published chunk.

nodes.name: bm25RankToScore
nodes.summary: Converts SQLite bm25() rank into a non-negative retrieval score.

nodes.name: getMemorySearchManager
nodes.summary: Resolves memory config/workspace access and returns a MemoryIndexManager (or error+debug).

nodes.name: searchMemoryCorpusSupplements
nodes.summary: Runs registered corpus supplements under a shared deadline and merges their scored results.

nodes.name: createMemorySearchTool
nodes.summary: Executes memory_search with corpus/deadline handling, wiki blending, citations and recall recording.

nodes.name: buildMemoryPromptSection
nodes.summary: Renders the Memory Recall prompt guidance lines based on available tools and citation mode.

nodes.name: scanSessionIngestionSource
nodes.summary: Scans one transcript source into bounded, provenance-stamped, deduped candidates for a day.

nodes.name: appendSessionCorpusLines
nodes.summary: Appends rendered ingest snippets to memory/.dreams/session-corpus/<day>.txt and returns per-line results.

nodes.name: recordMemoryEntryOrigins
nodes.summary: Records entry-to-session origin rows in the agent SQLite database via the CPU worker.

nodes.name: rankShortTermPromotionCandidates
nodes.summary: Scores staged recall entries with weighted signals and returns sorted promotion candidates.

nodes.name: isPromotionOriginBlocked
nodes.summary: Structurally blocks untrusted/system provenance from promotion before any prompt.

nodes.name: buildMemoryFlushPlan
nodes.summary: Builds the pre-compaction flush plan (prompt, systemPrompt, relativePath, thresholds).

nodes.name: matchStandingIntents
nodes.summary: Deterministically prefiltered keyword+scope matching of armed intents against an inbound prompt.

nodes.name: selectStrongTriggerMatches
nodes.summary: Scores stored trigger phrases against the message and returns top strong trusted matches.

nodes.name: resolveRecallEscalationDecision
nodes.summary: Decides whether lane-2 recall runs given mode, recall intent, and lane-1 hit strength.

nodes.name: createWikiSearchTool
nodes.summary: wiki_search tool: searches wiki pages and optionally the active memory corpus by title/path/id/body.

nodes.name: ensureMemoryIndexSchema
nodes.summary: Creates/migrates the full memory index schema and returns FTS availability.

nodes.name: classifySessionMessageOrigin
nodes.summary: Assigns the authoritative origin class to a transcript message.

nodes.name: extractCuratedEntryRecallMetadata
nodes.summary: Parses trigger/importance/project annotations into neutral-or-valued recall metadata.

nodes.name: prepareMemoryPromptSection
nodes.summary: Builds and freezes the run-scoped memory prompt lines from primary + supplement registrations.

nodes.name: buildMemorySystemPromptAddition
nodes.summary: Renders the active memory prompt section into a systemPromptAddition for plugin context engines.

nodes.name: buildProjectMemoryBootstrap
nodes.summary: Renders the budgeted project-scoped memory block from eligible curated entries.

nodes.name: createSessionsSearchTool
nodes.summary: Gateway-backed exact transcript search returning anchors for sessions_history.

nodes.name: MemorySearchOrchestration
nodes.summary: Abstract search class owning keyword+vector retrieval, provider fallback, index identity repair, and hybrid merge.

nodes.name: LegacyContextEngine
nodes.summary: Default ContextEngine implementation delegating compaction to the built-in runtime.

nodes.name: memory-tiers
nodes.summary: Five-tier memory model (instructions, curated core, episodic, prospective, review) with distinct write/inject rules.

nodes.name: provenance-origin-class
nodes.summary: SQLite-owned origin_class (owner/agent/untrusted/system) that prose cannot rewrite; gates promotion and injection.

nodes.name: hybrid-retrieval
nodes.summary: Parallel BM25 FTS + vector similarity fused by weights into one ranked candidate set.

nodes.name: temporal-decay
nodes.summary: 30-day half-life exponential decay for dated notes; curated files evergreen.

nodes.name: importance-ranking
nodes.summary: Write-time importance (1-10) multiplier so importance scoring needs no query-time model call.

nodes.name: mmr-diversity
nodes.summary: Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranking to reduce near-duplicate snippets.

nodes.name: trigger-recall
nodes.summary: Lane-1 deterministic lexical+vector prefilter over stored trigger phrases injecting up to 3 hidden entries at >=0.65.

nodes.name: recall-lanes
nodes.summary: Two-lane recall: always-on deterministic lane-1 vs costly lane-2 escalation sub-agent.

nodes.name: dreaming-consolidation
nodes.summary: Background sleep-time sweep (light/REM/deep) that merges and supersedes into MEMORY.md with DREAMS review.

nodes.name: promotion-gates
nodes.summary: Deterministic threshold + provenance exclusion before any consolidation prompt.

nodes.name: project-scoped-memory
nodes.summary: Repository-identity annotation driving ranking boost and auto-injection eligibility per active project keys.

nodes.name: memory-flush
nodes.summary: Silent pre-compaction turn that persists unwritten durable context to a daily note.

nodes.name: context-engine-legacy
nodes.summary: Built-in context engine: ingest no-op, assemble pass-through, compact delegate.

nodes.name: active-memory-escalation
nodes.summary: Blocking recall sub-agent run only on recall-intent turns with no lane-1 strong hit (mode escalate/always/off).

nodes.name: session-vs-memory-search
nodes.summary: memory_search returns session snippets as references; sessions_search/sessions_history give exact bounded excerpts.

nodes.name: multi-user-scoping
nodes.summary: Per-agent stores plus tools.sessions.visibility/agentToAgent governing cross-agent transcript hits.

nodes.name: memory-wiki
nodes.summary: Compiled claims/evidence wiki vault layered beside the active memory plugin (not a replacement).

nodes.name: honcho-external-provider
nodes.summary: External plugin persisting turns to a service, building user/agent models, injecting on before_prompt_build.

nodes.name: memory-forget-lineage
nodes.summary: Entry-origin + promotion-marker lineage enabling selective purge and permanent forgotten-session exclusion.

nodes.name: standing-intents
nodes.summary: Prospective memory compiled out of the model into SQLite intents with deterministic prefilter injection.

nodes.name: memory-core
nodes.summary: Memory Core plugin: file-backed search tools, index, dreaming, CLI, provenance and forget.

nodes.name: memory-host-sdk
nodes.summary: Shared memory host contracts, SQLite schema, embeddings adapters, and session projection.

nodes.name: context-engine
nodes.summary: Context engine registry and delegates controlling assembly/compaction/prompt injection.

nodes.name: active-memory
nodes.summary: Deep-recall lane plugin: trigger recall + escalation sub-agent + private transcript recall.

nodes.name: memory-wiki
nodes.summary: Knowledge-vault plugin: compiled wiki, claims, dashboards, wiki tools.

nodes.name: memory write pipeline
nodes.summary: conversation -> extraction (flush/ingestion/annotations) -> store (files+SQLite) -> retrieval (hybrid) -> prompt injection (bootstrap/trigger/escalation), with dreaming promotion feedback.

nodes.name: recall pipeline
nodes.summary: Query -> embed+tokenize -> vector+BM25 -> weighted merge -> decay/importance/project -> MMR -> top results -> tool/citation injection.
